titulo: The Signal From Space That Never Came Back
tema: Why did a radio signal from deep space, the Wow! signal of 1977, arrive once for seventy-two seconds and never come back? It lasted as long as the telescope could watch one spot of sky, so it pointed to space and not the ground. It sat right beside the natural radio note of hydrogen, the note scientists had guessed a distant civilization would use. Decades of searching that same patch of sky have found nothing.
